note: List of position codes used by the app, plus how out-of-position players are penalised. Eligibility comes from each player's own position list. Penalties are a tuning choice, not a game formula - adjust to taste.
note_penalty: out_of_position_penalty multiplies a player's slot score when they play a slot that is NOT in their eligible positions. gk_mismatch_penalty is applied when a non-GK is forced into GK or a GK is forced outfield (effectively prohibitive).
